arabic: إحياء السماوات — حد المعنى المجازي التشغيلي
missionPhraseAllowed: إعمار وإحياء السماوات بإذن الله وإن شاء الله
interpretation: metaphorical operational language only, meaning expansion of beneficial human knowledge, observation, navigation, timing, communications, satellite services, astronomy, remote sensing and responsible space activity
operationalDomains: responsible mitigation of human-made orbital debris where lawfully and technically feasible
